description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use to see when a calendar of an AI agent's system still has room, such as before proposing a time to a customer, for at most 31 days at a time. Not for what is booked already (use search_records on appointments).

calendar.description: The id of the calendar, as describe_record_type gives it with include stages on appointments.

from.description: The first day or moment, ISO 8601, such as 2026-11-02.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agent_options, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone to give the slots in, such as Europe/Amsterdam.

to.description: The last day or moment, ISO 8601, at most 31 days later; a day counts in full.

user.description: Only the slots of this user on a shared calendar, by the id describe_record_type gives with include users.

name: find_free_slots
title: Find free calendar slots
